updateTime.description: Timestamp of the last consolidation update of this splitted completeness document (UTC)

key.description: Unique identifier of the splitted completeness entry, built from datatake_id, timeliness and product_type

mission.description: Mission the datatake belongs to (e.g. S1, S3, S5)

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit of the datatake (e.g. S1A, S3B)

datatake_id.description: Identifier of the datatake whose production completeness is measured

observation_time_start.description: Start of the observation period covered by the produced products (UTC)

observation_time_stop.description: End of the observation period covered by the produced products (UTC)

observation_duration.description: Duration of the observation period in microseconds

timeliness.description: Timeliness of the products tracked by this completeness entry

product_type.description: Product type tracked by this completeness entry

product_level.description: Product level tracked by this completeness entry

absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number of the datatake

relative_orbit.description: Relative orbit number of the datatake

expected.description: Expected sensing value for this product type and timeliness, in microseconds, derived from the completeness configuration

value.description: Measured produced sensing value for this product type and timeliness, in microseconds

value_adjusted.description: Produced value capped at the expected value, in microseconds

percentage.description: Completeness percentage, computed as the adjusted value divided by the expected value

status.description: Completeness status evaluated from the percentage

cams_tickets.description: CAMS anomaly ticket identifiers attached to this completeness entry

last_attached_ticket.description: Identifier of the most recently attached CAMS anomaly ticket

last_attached_ticket_url.description: URL of the most recently attached CAMS anomaly ticket

cams_origin.description: Origin reported by the attached CAMS anomaly ticket(s)

cams_description.description: Description reported by the attached CAMS anomaly ticket(s)

service_type.description: Type of the production service providing the products (partition field)

service_id.description: Identifier of the production service instance providing the products (partition field)
